rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the preceding rite

items.question: Is the entire puraścaraṇa rite prescribed for vīras in the cremation ground at night?
premises: Performance occurs in cremation ground at night.
items.inference: Thus the rite is restricted to vīra practitioners in the cremation ground at night.
uncertainties: Whether vīraiḥ denotes practitioner grade or heroic beings.
items.plain_english: All this is prescribed to be performed by heroes in the cremation ground at night.
